title: Google Ads vs Local Services Ads for small business marketing - Google Ads

facts.fact: The article is dated August 2025 and states that Google Ads uses a pay-per-click model while Local Services Ads uses a pay-per-lead model.
facts.quote: Google Ads lets you target a broad audience and uses a pay-per-click model. Local Services Ads focuses on local leads with a pay-per-lead model.

facts.fact: As an illustrative example (not a benchmark), the article suggests a business goal of getting 30 new customer leads per month.
facts.quote: or get 30 new customer leads per month.

facts.fact: As an illustrative example (not a benchmark), the article suggests a business goal of increasing online sales by 20% over six months.
